FoldCounters.description: Running totals kept by the fold. Each at most [crate::limits::MAX_SAFE_WIRE_INTEGER].

HeldInputs.description:
Inputs held by a `resend` request. `request.resolved` outcome `resend` returns them to the
front of `queuedInputIds`; `dropped` discards them.

InputId.description: An input accepted into a thread's mailbox.

ItemId.description: A finished item inside a run (TurnItem id).

RequestKind.description: What kind of human step a request needs.

oneOf.description: A run settled as `unknown` waits for a person to choose resend or drop.
A choice among options (v1 `goat_decision_request`). Silence never approves.

itemId.description: The approval/question item, when the request came from the engine.

recommended.description: Kind `decision`: the recommended option id. Silence never approves it.

RunId.description: A run: one batch of inputs sent to the engine until the answer ends.

oneOf.description: Sent but not known to have reached the engine. Never re-sent automatically.

ThreadId.description: A GOAT thread. Also the folder name under `~/.goat2/threads/`.

description:
Fold state beyond the card: what a reader (or the store after a crash) needs to continue
folding from a checkpoint without reading earlier lines.

Fold rules (lane A store): `input.accepted` queues; `input.delivered` accepted leaves the
queue, declined stays queued and leaves `activeRunInputIds`, unknown moves into the active
run's hold. At `run.finished`, run inputs still queued are delivered if
`activeRunReachedEngine`, held if the outcome is `unknown`, else stay queued; an `unknown`
outcome opens request `resend:<runId>` (kind `resend`) holding them.

activeRunId.description: The run between `run.started` and `run.finished`, if any.

activeRunInputIds.description: Inputs carried by the active run's `run.started`.

activeRunReachedEngine.description:
True once `run.accepted`, an `item.completed` or `request.opened` for the active run, or
`input.delivered {as: turn, outcome: accepted}` for one of its inputs is folded (steer
deliveries do not count). Restart settlement: true -> `interrupted`, false -> `unknown`.

heldInputs.description: Inputs whose delivery is ambiguous, held by a resend request (one hold per run).

lastRunOutcome.description: Outcome of the last finished run, for the `failed` status after later events.

openRequests.description: Requests still open (including `resend`), so the inbox renders without earlier lines.

queuedInputIds.description: Inputs accepted but not yet delivered, in order.

runningChildIds.description: Children started and not yet reported; `card.children.running` is its length.
